podcast.body: "Icky Thump" by The White Stripes is cited as a rare, modern example of a rock song that consciously continues the tradition of the fade-out technique. Jack and Meg White's use of this ending method connects their work to a practice spanning over 300 years in musical history. "It's the white stripes and Iki-Thong."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Ongoing History Book of Firsts
